description: Example robot (not a default): the LEGO EV3 educator base. Large motors on B (left) and C (right), a medium motor on A, four sensors. `pair` are the ports of the synced motor pair `ev3.pair`, `hardware` the facts about the brick that are not motion limits (`tone_volume_pct` is read on stock firmware, `speech_volume_pct` on ev3dev), `profile` a contract RobotProfile (CONTRACT.md §3). `profile.drivetrain.heading` names the channel that measures the heading of a move, by the role `gyro`; a base without it measures the heading from its wheel encoders. The twin r1-sim is built from this same file.

notes: Colour sensor points down, 7 cm ahead of the axle.
Distance sensor looks forward from the front edge.
